Batman figure spotted atop Sydney Opera House

A figure resembling Batman was observed on the roof of the Sydney Opera House, sparking speculation about potential filming for 'The Batman Part II'. The appearance of the costumed individual atop the iconic landmark led to questions regarding its purpose. While some reports suggest a possible connection to the filming of the upcoming Batman sequel, no official confirmation has been provided.
